name: Dash testnet faucet
author: ktechmidas
description: Web faucet for the Dash testnet. It sends 1 tDASH to a testnet address and creates Dash Platform identities, with the keys generated in the browser. Useful when a test needs a small amount of testnet funds or a fresh identity.
access: Public web page. For larger testnet amounts, the infrastructure team in #infra-claw is who to ask.
